channel.title: Warhammer 40k Community RSS Feed
channel.description: Latest intelligence reports from the Warhammer Community

item.title: Trench Grime on Krieg Artillery with Contrast paints | Warhammer 40,000
item.description: The video demonstrates how to effectively use Contrast paints to achieve a realistic trench grime effect on Krieg artillery models in Warhammer 40,000.

item.title: Sunday Preview – The galaxy calls, and Krieg answers
item.description: The article previews upcoming Warhammer releases, highlighting new models and sets for the Krieg faction, alongside other game-related products set to enhance the gaming experience.

item.title: Astartes II – Official Teaser Trailer | Warhammer+
item.description: The "Astartes II – Official Teaser Trailer" on Warhammer+ showcases a thrilling glimpse into the next chapter of the acclaimed fan-made film project, promising intense action and deeper exploration into the Warhammer 40,000 universe.

item.title: Astartes II Teaser Trailer – Watch it right now
item.description: The article announces and provides a link to watch the teaser trailer for "Astartes II," the highly anticipated sequel to the fan-made Warhammer 40,000 animation.

item.title: This year’s Warhammer event miniatures revealed
item.description: The article unveils the exclusive miniatures released for this year's Warhammer events, featuring unique characters and models that cater to fans and collectors of the Warhammer universe.

item.title: Warhammer Studio Interview – Designing the new Phoenix Lords and Aspect Warriors
item.description: The Warhammer Studio article discusses the creative process and design considerations taken by the team in updating the models of the Phoenix Lords and Aspect Warriors, focusing on enhancing their iconic features while maintaining the rich lore and aesthetic continuity of the Warhammer universe.

item.title: Phoenix Lords and Aspect Warriors painted by the wider Warhammer Hobby Community
item.description: The article showcases a vibrant collection of Phoenix Lords and Aspect Warriors expertly painted by members of the Warhammer hobby community, highlighting the creativity and skill within the fandom.

item.title: New Phoenix Lords with Contrast! | Warhammer 40,000
item.description: The article introduces new Phoenix Lords models for Warhammer 40,000, highlighting the use of Contrast paints to achieve striking, detailed finishes effortlessly.

item.title: Aeldari Corsair showcase: The Ballad of the Sky Serpents
item.description: The article "Aeldari Corsair Showcase: The Ballad of the Sky Serpents" on the Warhammer Community website features a detailed look at a beautifully painted Aeldari Corsair army, highlighting their unique aesthetics and the creative narrative behind their design.

item.title: How to use the Ynnari and Harlequins in the new Codex: Aeldari
item.description: The article provides strategies and synergies for effectively using Ynnari and Harlequins factions within the new Codex: Aeldari to maximize their unique abilities and strengths in Warhammer 40k gameplay.

item.title: Codex: Aeldari masters combat with eight powerful Detachments to choose from
item.description: The new Codex: Aeldari enriches Warhammer 40K gameplay by offering players a choice of eight diverse and powerful Detachments to enhance their strategic options in battle.

item.title: Who are the Phoenix Lords? The legendary Aeldari heroes explained
item.description: The Phoenix Lords are the immortal, legendary heroes of the Aeldari, each embodying the pinnacle of the Aspect Warrior path, leading their kind in battle with extraordinary skills and ancient wisdom.
